question.zh: TypeScript 里什么时候让编译器推断、什么时候手写类型注解?返回类型要不要写?satisfies 该怎么用?
question.en: In TypeScript, when should the compiler infer and when should you write an annotation? Should you write return types? How should satisfies be used?

text.zh: 写应用代码时尽量依靠推断:从已有的值和类型推出新类型,而不是重复声明。注解用在需要「约束」或「拓宽」的地方;satisfies 用于既要检查又要保留字面量的地方。返回类型要不要写,他的建议前后改过几次,最新的看法尚不明确。
text.en: In application code, lean on inference. Derive types from existing values and types instead of declaring them again. Annotate to constrain or widen. Use satisfies to check a value while keeping its literal types. His advice on return types has changed several times; his latest position is unclear.

anchors.quote: When writing application-level TypeScript, you should be using inference as much as possible.
anchors.quote_zh: 写应用层 TypeScript 时,应该尽可能依靠推断。

title.zh: 默认让 TypeScript 推断,用类型工具从已有类型派生
title.en: Let TypeScript infer by default; derive from existing types

how.zh: 应用代码里先不写类型,看推断结果是否够用。需要新类型时,用 Omit、Pick、Partial 之类从已有类型派生(他把这也算作推断的一种),而不是另写一份。
how.en: In application code, write no types at first and see whether inference is enough. When you need a new type, derive it from existing ones with Omit, Pick, Partial and the like (he counts that as inference too) rather than writing another copy.

anchors.quote: using type helpers like Omit, Pick, Partial is just another form of inference.
anchors.quote_zh: 使用 Omit、Pick、Partial 这类类型工具,只是推断的另一种形式。

title.zh: 理解推断规则:let 和 const 推断不同
title.en: Know the inference rules: let and const infer differently

how.zh: 很多「奇怪」的报错来自推断规则:const 声明的值不会变,会被推断成字面量;let 会被拓宽成 string、number。弄懂这一点,很多问题不需要加注解就能解决。
how.en: Many odd errors come from inference rules: a const value never changes and is inferred as a literal; let widens to string or number. Once you understand this, many problems go away without annotations.

anchors.quote: people figure out that let and const infer differently.
anchors.quote_zh: 人们发现 let 和 const 的推断方式不同。

anchors.quote: If TypeScript knows a value can't change, it'll infer it
anchors.quote_zh: 如果 TypeScript 知道一个值不会变,它就会把它推断为

title.zh: 需要检查又要保留字面量时用 satisfies;需要拓宽时用变量注解
title.en: satisfies to check and keep literals; a variable annotation to widen

how.zh: satisfies 检查值是否符合某个类型,但保留推断出的精确类型;变量注解会覆盖推断(包括 as const 的效果),适合需要把类型拓宽的场景,比如往 Record 里继续加键。
how.en: satisfies checks that a value fits a type but keeps the precise inferred type; a variable annotation overrides inference (including the effect of as const), which suits cases where the type should widen, such as adding more keys to a Record.

anchors.quote: To get the behaviour you want, use 'satisfies' instead.
anchors.quote_zh: 要得到想要的行为,改用 satisfies。

anchors.quote: To widen the type of a variable, use a variable annotation.
anchors.quote_zh: 要拓宽变量的类型,用变量注解。

title.zh: 返回类型:默认少写,在「挖坑」和容易出错处写
title.en: Return types: few by default, written for typed holes and error-prone spots

how.zh: 2023 年他主张大多数情况下少写返回类型;同年也指出显式返回类型适合做「typed holes」——先写好签名、晚点再实现。2024 年他承认有一次漏写返回类型让他多调了一两个小时 bug。2025-04 他表示这条建议「又变了」,新的说法放在帖子附带的链接里,最新立场尚不明确。
how.en: In 2023 he argued for leaving return types out most of the time. He also used explicit return types for typed holes: write the signature now, implement it later. In 2024 he said a missing return type had cost him an hour or two of debugging. In April 2025 he said his advice had changed again, linking to the new advice. His latest position is unclear.

anchors.quote: mostly they just slow you down.
anchors.quote_zh: 大多数时候它们只会拖慢你。

anchors.quote: My recommendation for return types has changed again
anchors.quote_zh: 我对返回类型的建议又变了

title.zh: 跟上编译器:新版本能推断的,就别再手写
title.en: Keep up with the compiler: don't hand-write what it now infers

how.zh: TS 5.5 起,返回收窄表达式的函数会自动推断出类型谓词,不再需要手写 val is string。升级后检查能删掉哪些多余注解。
how.en: From TS 5.5, a function that returns a narrowing expression gets an inferred type predicate, so val is string no longer needs writing by hand. After upgrading, check which annotations can go.

anchors.quote: No more 'val is string' to force TypeScript's hand.
anchors.quote_zh: 不必再写 val is string 来逼 TypeScript 就范。

title.zh: 本站示例:satisfies 与变量注解的分工
title.en: Our example: satisfies versus a variable annotation

title.zh: 他澄清 satisfies 的长帖(2023)

text.zh: 给每个函数都写返回类型,把推断能做的事重复一遍。
text.en: Writing a return type on every function, repeating what inference already does.

anchors.quote: I think you should be using return types MUCH less often than you are right now.
anchors.quote_zh: 我觉得你写返回类型的频率应该比现在低得多。

text.zh: 反过来也有代价:漏写返回类型,错误可能出现在远离源头的地方。
text.en: The opposite has a cost too: without a return type, an error can surface far from its source.

anchors.quote: I just spent 1-2 hours struggling to fix a bug that specifying a return type on my function would have fixed.
anchors.quote_zh: 我刚花了一两个小时修一个 bug,其实给函数写上返回类型就能避免。

text.zh: 把 as const 和变量注解混用:注解会覆盖 as const,属性又变回可变。
text.en: Mixing as const with a variable annotation: the annotation overrides as const and the properties become mutable again.

anchors.quote: 'as const' doesn't play nicely with variable annotations.
anchors.quote_zh: as const 和变量注解合不来。

stance.zh: 「派生而不是声明」,用类型工具和 satisfies 的前身(satisfies()() 模式)尽量多推断。
stance.en: Derive rather than declare: infer as much as possible with type helpers and the forerunner of satisfies (the satisfies()() pattern).

stance.zh: 应用代码尽量依靠推断;返回类型大多数时候只会拖慢你。
stance.en: Lean on inference in application code; return types mostly just slow you down.

stance.zh: 承认显式返回类型的价值:typed holes;因漏写返回类型多调 bug。
stance.en: He grants the value of explicit return types: typed holes; a missing return type cost him extra debugging.

stance.zh: 说对返回类型的建议「又变了」,新的说法放在帖子附带的链接里,最新立场尚不明确。
stance.en: He says his return-type advice has changed again and links to the new advice. His latest position is unclear.
